metadata.title: Rema — Dream journal by Antoine Ghigny
metadata.description: Your dream journal for iPhone. Keep your memories, find what returns and explore your story over time. Rema, an app by Antoine Ghigny.

hero.title: Your dreams have more to tell.
hero.description: Keep a trace of your nights. Find the people, places and feelings that return. Take the time to see what your journal tells you about yourself.
hero.note: An app by Antoine Ghigny, developed in Belgium.
hero.caption: Illustrative journal interface. Fictional dreams and data.

preview.label: Explore a product example
preview.search: A person, a place, a memory…

dream1.title: The house by the sea
dream1.summary: An open door, the sound of waves. Léa is waiting for me on the terrace.

dream2.title: The morning train
dream2.summary: The train crosses a forest. I get off at a station I don't recognise.

dream3.title: The beach at dusk
dream3.summary: I walk along the water with Léa. We look for blue stones.

dream4.title: The crossing
dream4.summary: I'm on a small boat. The water is calm and I see the coast in the distance.

preview.threadDescription: One place, at three points in your journal. Return to each memory to find its context.
preview.weeklyBody: On the train on 21 September, you arrive somewhere unfamiliar. On the 28th, an open door and someone you know are waiting for you.
preview.weeklyQuestion: What place makes you feel you belong today?

product.title: A night fades. A journal stays.
product.intro: Rema is built around a simple habit: keep what you remember, then return to it with a little distance.
product.captureTitle: The memory, as it comes back.
product.captureBody: Speak your dream aloud or write a few lines. A detail is enough to begin. Find your story again, correct it and add what comes back to you.
product.connectBody: Find recurring people, places, feelings and themes. Watch them change across your own journal, with the original dreams close at hand.
product.reflectBody: Read a weekly recap linked to your dreams or ask your journal a question. Your memories remain the starting point; their meaning is yours to explore.
product.quote: I mostly remember the light on the water. And wanting to stay.
product.quoteSource: An excerpt from a fictional dream
product.saved: A fragment can become a memory.
product.principleBody: No dream to get right, no conclusion to accept. Rema invites you to notice your own story and add your own words.

next.septemberLead: The sea returns. The setting changes.
next.septemberBody: A boat on the 4th, a beach on the 12th, a house on the 28th. The sea appears in three of your four September dreams. Léa is in the last two: what stands out when you read them together?
next.septemberQuestion: What do you associate with these places where you can take your time?
next.augustBody: The library on 8 August and the garden on the 19th are two different places where you take your time looking for something. Do these memories bring a moment of waking life to mind?
next.augustQuestion: What were you looking for in each of these dreams?

about.title: A dream becomes a project.
about.description: Meet Rema, the dream journal for iPhone developed by Antoine Ghigny, an independent developer in Nivelles, Belgium.
about.intro: I'm Antoine Ghigny. I'm building Rema, a dream journal to keep memories of the night and support personal reflection over time.
about.whyBody: A single dream can leave an impression. A journal lets you return to it, recognise a person or place and see how your memories change. That continuity is what I want to make easier with Rema.
about.nowTitle: An app to revisit your nights.
about.nowBody: Rema brings together voice and written capture, a journal, recurring patterns, weekly recaps and questions linked to original dreams. Its App Store launch is in preparation.
about.nextBody: Monthly recaps and personal guidance are planned next. The website previews let you explore that direction.
about.companyBody: Rema is the product name. The business is operated by Antoine Ghigny, an independent developer based in Nivelles, Belgium. You speak directly with the person building it.

faq.title: Before you begin.
faq.description: Answers about Rema, the dream journal for iPhone, its App Store launch and upcoming features.
faq.intro: A few answers about Rema, its launch and the website previews.

q1.question: What is Rema?
q1.answer: Rema is a mobile dream journal under development. It helps you keep memories, find recurring people, places, feelings and themes, and explore how they change over time.

q2.question: Can I download Rema already?
q2.answer: Rema's App Store launch is in preparation. To hear when it is available, you can write to Antoine using the link on this page.

q3.question: What can I do with Rema?
q3.answer: Capture dreams by speaking or writing, find them in your journal, explore recurring people, places, feelings and themes, and follow their evolution. Weekly recaps and questions to the journal invite further reflection based on the original dreams.

q4.question: What about monthly recaps or personal guidance?
q4.answer: They are planned next for Rema. The website previews show the direction: revisit a month with its source dreams, then explore questions and small actions connected to a goal you choose. These features are not yet available in the app.

q5.question: Are the dreams shown here real?
q5.answer: No. All dreams, patterns and recaps in the previews are fictional. The interfaces illustrate the journal and its upcoming features; they are not user testimonials.

q6.question: Does Rema give my dreams a definitive meaning?
q6.answer: Rema is a tool for personal reflection. Its prompts start from your journal and leave room for your own perspective. They are neither a diagnosis nor a promise of therapeutic results.

q7.question: How can I hear when Rema is available?
q7.answer: Write to contact@antoineghigny.be using the link on this page. It opens your email app: you choose to send the email to ask about the launch. The site does not create an account or sign you up automatically.

q8.question: What happens to my data on this website?
q8.answer: The demos do not ask for any dreams and their selections stay in your browser. The privacy policy explains email correspondence, hosting and website analytics. The app's terms will be provided when it launches.

The contact link opens your email app. If you send an email, your address and the information you choose to share are used to answer your request and, if you ask, tell you about Rema's launch. You do not need to share a dream to contact us. Correspondence is retained for as long as needed to handle your request, subject to applicable legal obligations.

These tools do not use advertising cookies. They do not receive the content of your emails. Vercel is based in the United States.
privacy.cookiesBody: A technical NEXT_LOCALE cookie remembers the website language. A display preference may be stored locally by the website's theme system. No advertising pixel or dream collection form is added to the Rema pages.
privacy.rightsBody: You can request access to, correction or deletion of information you have shared, and restrict or object to processing under the applicable conditions. Write to contact@antoineghigny.be. You can also lodge a complaint with the Belgian Data Protection Authority.
